title: CI 33164294061 root-cause diagnosis
body: GitHub run https://github.com/xiaden/Universeity/actions/runs/33164294061 at commit a6b1a62 failed for multiple independent causes. Hosted logs/artifacts prove: unit job 1 failure from test_docker_compose_config_when_daemon_present because required HATCHET_COOKIE_SECRET was absent; Postgres job 14 failures = six multipart failures with Starlette assertion that python-multipart is not installed, six ffmpeg FileNotFoundError failures, one pg_dump FileNotFoundError at /usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin/pg_dump, one same Compose interpolation assertion; Docker job fails before startup at GHCR manifest request for ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet:v0.105.2 with denied, so all later readiness/E2E steps skipped. Code/design evidence shows product integration gap beyond environment: app.py imports/instantiates DurableDAGRunner, while ProductionDAGRunner is the Hatchet submission seam; existing dedicated live tests at test_hatchet_live.py:920-1006 use real-client shape but handoff also records defective recording-client tests with executor=None; worker extra is optional in pyproject and Dockerfile base install needs inspection. This is NEEDS_PLAN, not SIMPLE; R&D planning then Exec-Manager required. No code modified by debugger.

title: Plan J remains blocked by hosted evidence
body: Run 33164294061 confirms the Plan J dependency block recorded in exec-manager log L57: Docker startup fails at Hatchet GHCR image pull denial, PostgreSQL/unit environments miss required runtime dependencies and Compose secrets, and product Hatchet execution is not proven. Plan J phases 3-4 must not be marked complete; R&D design and implementation planning are required before Exec-Manager.

title: CI-only hypothesis eliminated
body: For run 33164294061, hypothesis that the failure was only a test assertion regression is eliminated. Hosted evidence spans six multipart dependency failures, six missing ffmpeg failures, one missing pg_dump failure, two Compose secret interpolation failures, GHCR Hatchet image denial before startup, and a distinct production API runner mismatch. Lint and strict mypy passing cannot establish runtime/deployment correctness.
